mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO dlp_scans (file_id, version_id, scope, status, attempts, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{fileId}, #{versionId}, #{scope}, 'PENDING', 0, #{now}, #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT id, file_id AS fileId, version_id AS versionId, scope, attempts FROM dlp_scans WHERE status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE dlp_scans SET status = 'PROCESSING', attempts = attempts + 1, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE dlp_scans SET status = 'COMPLETED', verdict = #{verdict}, total_score = #{totalScore}, threshold = #{threshold}, max_severity = #{maxSeverity}, finding_count = #{findingCount}, method = #{method}, note = #{note}, last_error = NULL, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id}

INSERT INTO dlp_findings (scan_id, pattern_name, severity, score, verified, match_offset, match_length, masked_value, scored) VALUES

mapper.select: SELECT id, file_id AS fileId, version_id AS versionId, scope, status, verdict, total_score AS totalScore, threshold, max_severity AS maxSeverity, finding_count AS findingCount, method, note, attempts, last_error AS lastError, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM dlp_scans WHERE version_id = #{versionId} AND scope = #{scope} LIMIT 1

SELECT pattern_name AS patternName, severity, score, verified, match_offset AS matchOffset, match_length AS matchLength, masked_value AS maskedValue, scored FROM dlp_findings WHERE scan_id = #{scanId} ORDER BY match_offset ASC, id ASC

SELECT id, version_id AS versionId, scope, status, verdict, total_score AS totalScore, max_severity AS maxSeverity, finding_count AS findingCount, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM dlp_scans WHERE file_id = #{fileId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE dlp_scans SET status = 'PENDING', attempts = 0, verdict = NULL, total_score = NULL, max_severity = NULL, finding_count = 0, note = NULL, last_error = NULL, updated_at = #{now} WHERE version_id = #{versionId} AND scope = #{scope}
